author: Number1E
body: I was banned back on April 16th 2014 by Riskayyy for Hacking-Killaura. I realize this was wrong on my part and accepted the consequences when it happened. To be honest i forgot about the server until just now when my brother tried to play on his account and was banned for ban evasion. He told me and for a second i didn't know what he was talking about then i remembered that i was banned. I have since then deleted all mods/hacks i had and haven't used them in a long time(because of this incident, i remember really liking nebula and to this day cant find another nebula server). I believe i have served a long enough punishment and would like to be considered for an unban.
